description: This file defines the 'Invoice' class for the vtiger CRM system, extending CRMEntity. It includes methods for saving, retrieving related activities and history, handling status history, report query generation, relationship management, and creating recurring invoices from sales orders. It manages invoice data, relationships, and related operations within the module.

classes.name: Invoice
classes.description: Represents the Invoice module in vtiger CRM, handling invoice data, relationships, history, status, and recurring invoice creation.

methods.name: Invoice
methods.description: Constructor initializing logger, database connection, and column fields.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Handles module-specific save operations, including updating sales order status, creating recurring invoices, and updating currency info.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the invoice's name for summary display.

methods.name: get_activities
methods.description: Retrieves activities related to the invoice.

methods.name: get_history
methods.description: Fetches activity history related to the invoice.

methods.name: get_invoicestatushistory
methods.description: Retrieves the status change history of the invoice.

methods.name: get_column_value
methods.description: Overrides parent method to handle specific column value retrieval.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Generates secondary query parts for report related to the invoice.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation tables for related modules.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Unlinks the invoice from related entities.

methods.name: createRecurringInvoiceFromSO
methods.description: Creates a recurring invoice from a sales order, copying products, taxes, and updating stock and totals.
